data: For the fiscal year ended June 30, 2024 (fiscal 2024), Microsoft reported total revenue of about $245.1 billion ($245,122 million) and net income of about $88.1 billion ($88,136 million). Revenue rose roughly 16% (about 15.7%) from $211.9 billion in fiscal 2023, the year ended June 30, 2023. Net income grew about 22% from $72.4 billion in fiscal 2023, and diluted earnings per share were $11.80, up from $9.68.
